title: lomatium dissectum var. eatonii
intro: Lomatium dissectum var. eatonii, commonly known as Desert Biscuit or Cook's Biscuit, is a perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help in relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium dissectum var. eatonii include expectorant, antitussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which make it a potential remedy for respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
